purpose: Public/share-safe sell-now projections synced from Systemia Core. This catalog exposes verified commercial state and terms without exposing private control-plane data.

offers.name: Evercraft Website Launch Service
offers.problem: A business needs a professional website built or upgraded without operating a site-builder interface.
intent_terms: launch a website for my company
make me a professional business site
offers.pricing: Human-Finished Pro Site $500 one-time; Premium Custom Build $999 one-time; Total Business Launch $1,999 one-time.
offers.confirmation: Buyer explicitly chooses a tier and confirms payment before checkout. Fulfillment begins only after independent payment verification.

offers.name: Systemia Website Audit
offers.problem: A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.
intent_terms: why is my website not getting leads
why is my contractor website not ranking
why is my site slow on mobile
offers.pricing: Free preview. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.
offers.confirmation: Free preview creates no obligation. Paid tiers require explicit user confirmation before checkout and provider-verified payment before fulfillment.

offers.name: AliEV EV Site Opportunity Intelligence
offers.problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs source-backed EV infrastructure opportunity intelligence for a specific address or market.
intent_terms: is this site good for EV charging
should I install EV chargers at this property
offers.pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report; $250 Qualified Opportunity Pack pilot; $2,500/month Territory Opportunity Feed.
offers.confirmation: Agents may discover AliEV and prepare a paid handoff. Checkout creation requires explicit human action and paid fulfillment requires provider verification.

offers.name: FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief
offers.problem: A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.
intent_terms: research this land or water question
give me an evidence brief on this region
offers.pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time.
offers.confirmation: Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission.

offers.name: FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt
offers.problem: A difficult, ambiguous, obsolete, discontinued or hard-to-source part is blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project.
intent_terms: find a donor or salvage part
offers.pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
offers.confirmation: User explicitly chooses an offer and confirms payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.

offers.name: Evercraft Deck Engine Founding Capital Fit Sprint
offers.problem: A founder, operator or project owner needs bounded capital-path research, readiness gaps and evidence-led deck direction.
intent_terms: help me find funding for my business
which lenders or programs fit my business
help me prepare for SBA financing
offers.pricing: $49 one-time for the Founding Capital Fit Sprint, limited to the first 20 paid cases; $49 credited toward a later Capital Package upgrade.
offers.confirmation: User explicitly confirms before checkout. Fulfillment starts only after provider-verified payment.

offers.name: EventWave Event / Venue Promotion
offers.problem: An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.
offers.pricing: Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.
offers.confirmation: Explicit purchase confirmation and verified payment are required. Source review must pass before any public placement activates.

offers.problem: A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.
intent_terms: help me prepare for this interview
mock interview me for this job
offers.pricing: Free/basic practice; Interview Sprint $19 one-time for 7 days with up to 25 premium actions.
offers.confirmation: Free/basic practice creates no payment obligation. The $19 Sprint requires explicit user confirmation before checkout.

offers.confirmation: Explicit user confirmation is required before checkout. Paid output is generated only after independent Stripe verification.

offers.confirmation: Explicit buyer authorization for source access and payment is required.
